simple.meaning: נוּס (nûwç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to flit , i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 161 times in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 14:10. The surrounding contexts include kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נוּס (H5127) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נוּס (nûwç) / H5127 is traced through Genesis 14:10, Genesis 19:20, Genesis 39:12, Genesis 39:13 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to flit , i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)
